rationale: The AE14/D2 offline error preferences failed to predict Object/Spatial success and both paths lost Long quality. Use the already usable AE14/D3 anchor68/80 and test four one-layer swaps directly in closed loop, keeping Fast depth/NFE fixed. Do not use offline MSE as task-success evidence.

neighborhood.reason: Layers4 and9 are the next omissions in the existing nested AE12 mask [2,4,6,7,8,9]. Restoring one anchor omission while skipping one of these keeps14 layers. This structural choice does not assume task preferences.

fixed_science.sampler: Unmodified original Pi0Adapter.sample uniform EulerD3; no released-native-D3-kernel equivalence claim.
fixed_science.compensation: Unused with empty VLM masks; existing own-Full timestamps retained.

calibration.requirement: Original adapter no-bypass parity1e-5,actual layer visits/NFE/time nodes,full prefix/period/reset; eight known Full/AE14D3 trajectories bitwise identical across two source roots.
calibration.fixed_cost: All six definitions on each service; four real bank inputs,6 warmups plus12 measured requests per condition, whole three-request policy cycles.

discovery.candidates: Four new one-swap paths and the unchanged usable AE14/D3 anchor. Full is a quality/cost reference, not a selectable fast path.
discovery.qualify: Both overall>=.75 and>=Full-.15; each median completed-service Full/path native cost ratio>=1.15, pair costs within10%; opposite distinct-suite success gaps>=10pp,>=2 positive tasks per direction, all task LOO positive.
discovery.ranking: Maximum minimum directional count gap,then sum gaps,then minimum overall successes,then lexical path/suite ids. Freeze exactly one pair after all320 new and160 original records are validated.
discovery.reuse: Original Full80 and AE14D3 80 retain actual source identities. Known init45–46 discovery states are not independent confirmation.

confirmation.conditions: New Full and exactly two frozen paths
confirmation.primary: One-sided exact ten-task signflip including ties; Holm2 for exactly two frozen directions.
confirmation.success: Both differences positive,task-signflip Holm2p<.05,whole-task bootstrap lower>0,all task LOOpositive; both quality/native-cost gates and10% pair cost gate pass.

no_candidate: Preserve the bounded negative,keep confirmation locked,never lower scientific gates. This branch ending does not complete the overall goal.
limits: Suite-level fixed-path comparison only. No phase detector,online routing gain,exclusive-GPU or closed-loop acceleration claim. Multiple exploratory branches do not imply study-wide5% error control.
